name: price-breakdown-popover
title: Price breakdown popover
description: A price you can press to see how it is made up: base, discounts, shipping and VAT as lines that add up to the total, with the rate named.
docs: total is what the customer pays, in minor units (4900 is 49.00). lines are { label, amount, kind?, rate?, note? } with kind 'charge' (the default), 'discount' or 'tax'. They render as a real table: a discount shows a minus and the word Discount, a tax shows its rate ('VAT 21%'), and a rule above the total makes the sum readable. Charges add, a discount (passed positive) is taken off, and taxes are added too unless includesTax is on, where they are already in the total and listed under it as 'Includes VAT 21%'. In development a console warning says so when the lines do not add up to the total. Money is formatted in the given currency and locale from whole minor units. The trigger is a button named 'Price breakdown, 49.00 euros' that shows the total with an info icon, or your own trigger; the popover is not modal, so the page stays usable. title, align, open, defaultOpen and onOpenChange work as you would expect (a popover that starts open does not take the focus), and labels holds the fixed words. The trigger has no negative margin, so it never reaches over the word before it; pass className="-ml-1" to line a price up with the text above it. sumOf() in breakdown.ts is the same sum.
